rationale: Eric is building realtime AI avatar foundation models at North Model Labs, while Shryas invests in and researches AI and robotics at Kindred Ventures with a specific focus on embodied AI systems and foundation model applications. intro_message: Eric Sheen, meet Shryas Bhurat — Shryas leads AI and robotics investments at Kindred Ventures and would be valuable to talk with about your realtime avatar foundation models, especially given his focus on embodied AI and fine-tuning strategies.
